notes: Fixes being signed out of FleetComm entirely over a one-second network blip. While connected, FleetComm checks your account every 12 seconds, and until now a single failed check — a Wi-Fi roam, the game briefly saturating your connection — was treated the same as your access being revoked: every net torn down, Discord session gone, back to the sign-in screen, often with a raw error code like ECONNRESET as the only explanation. Now only a real answer from the accounts service signs you out (an expired session, revoked access); a check that simply didn't get through holds your nets and quietly retries, and if the outage lasts you get one plain-language note instead of an ejection. The invisible control connection — the one that keeps the ATC board and net editing working — also now heals itself after a drop like your tuned nets already did, instead of silently taking those features down until the next sign-in.
